units.source_text: 最终，还是我的哥哥被逼无奈才卖掉的……

en.t: In the end, it was my elder brother who had no choice but to sell them...

units.source_text: 同样，他现在也不在人世了。

en.t: He too is no longer among the living now.

units.source_text: 那时候，哥哥还是个容易冲动的好强的十八岁男孩。

en.t: At that time, my brother was still an impulsive, proud eighteen-year-old boy.

units.source_text: 哥哥应该算是一个文明开化的人。

en.t: My brother could probably be considered an enlightened modern man.

units.source_text: 他经常看英文读本，热衷政治。

en.t: He often read English readers and was passionate about politics.

units.source_text: 只要有人提起雏人偶，

en.t: Whenever someone brought up the hina dolls,

units.source_text: 他就轻蔑地说女儿节之类的不过是陈旧陋习，

en.t: he would say contemptuously that things like the Girls' Festival were nothing but outdated bad customs,

units.source_text: 摆那种没什么实际用处的东西又有什么用呢？

en.t: and ask what use there was in displaying things with no practical purpose.

units.source_text: 为了这件事，哥哥和尊重传统的母亲争执了很多次。

en.t: Over this matter, my brother argued many times with our tradition-respecting mother.

units.source_text: 但是只要卖了雏人偶，

en.t: But if we sold the hina dolls,

units.source_text: 至少可以让全家安然度过年关，

en.t: at least the whole family could get safely through the end of the year,

units.source_text: 因此也没有在为了筹钱而焦头烂额的父亲面前坚持自己的想法。

en.t: so he did not insist on his own opinion in front of our father, who was frantic over raising money.

units.source_text: 正想前面所说的，

en.t: Just as I said earlier,

units.source_text: 雏人偶已经决定在十一月卖给在横滨住的美国人了。

en.t: it had already been decided that the hina dolls would be sold in November to an American living in Yokohama.

units.source_text: 你问我吗？

en.t: Are you asking me?

units.source_text: 你问我当时有什么想法？

en.t: Are you asking what I thought at the time?

units.source_text: 虽然难免有些抱怨，

en.t: Although I naturally had some complaints,

units.source_text: 不过我原本就是个大大咧咧的女孩子，

en.t: I was, after all, an easygoing sort of girl to begin with,

units.source_text: 况且父亲答应我雏人偶卖掉之后

en.t: and besides, Father promised me that after the hina dolls were sold,

units.source_text: 要买一条紫色绸缎腰带送给我。

en.t: he would buy me a purple silk sash.
